html:
If you’re concerned about your home’s security, consider installing home privacy window tint on your windows. In addition to adding an effective layer of privacy, these window tints could also help:

  • Reduce exposure to ultraviolet radiation – help reduce the amount of UV rays on you, your family and carpets and furnishings. Keep your furniture and carpets looking newer for longer with reduced UV exposure.
  • Add a touch of colour and design – by installing a decorative home window privacy film you could mimic the look of stained windows or the effect of frosted glass on your existing window surfaces without having to replace them.
  • Reduce your energy consumption – privacy window tint could help reduce the energy exchange through your home’s windows, improve the energy efficiency all year round.
